beats.text: Number four. At the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, Trump stood in a packed arena and said the one thing every camera in the room could disprove.

beats.caption: No empty seats. The fake news.
beats.label: via FOX 26 Houston

beats.text: CNN counted the gaps in the bleachers row by row. Two nights later, same venue, he moved on from seats to receipts.

beats.caption: prices and almost every other item are rapidly going down.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: Grocery bills across the country disagreed, but nobody hands a receipt to a man mid-applause.

beats.caption: Every single promise I've made to you as a candidate, I've delivered on.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: Three claims, three fact-checks, zero accuracy. At some point, lying about how full a room is stops being spin and starts being performance art.
